halloween.lobby.st.stamina.2: Standing still or hiding, your breath comes back twice as fast.
halloween.lobby.st.stamina.3: Watching Michael or finding a body builds panic: heartbeat, shaking.
halloween.lobby.st.stamina.4: Panic fades far from him and from bodies.
halloween.lobby.tip.10: Tip: each storm cellar lets out only one.
halloween.lobby.tip.11: Tip: the car waits until two are in or the driver presses Space.
halloween.lobby.tip.12: Tip: perks are on key P.
halloween.lobby.tip.2: Tip: a locked door holds Michael up for several blows.
halloween.lobby.tip.3: Tip: a flashlight in his face blinds Michael.
halloween.lobby.tip.4: Tip: a townsperson led to an exit is worth +200.
halloween.lobby.tip.5: Tip: in fog they notice you closer, and you see less too.

halloween.lobby.tip.7: Tip: the police can only be called once a body is found.
halloween.lobby.tip.8: Tip: panting carries: catch your breath under cover.
halloween.lobby.tip.9: Tip: the flare gun and the rifle knock Michael down in one hit.

halloween.heroinfo.laurie.story: A quiet straight-A girl from Haddonfield. Babysitting on Lampkin Lane again tonight, and all day she has felt someone following her.
halloween.heroinfo.laurie.quote: It's just someone in a mask… right?
halloween.heroinfo.laurie.skill: For a few seconds she sees Michael through walls, wherever he is.
halloween.heroinfo.laurie.trait: He is after her, but he stalks her more slowly than the others.
halloween.heroinfo.annie.story: Sheriff Brackett's daughter. Her phone is busy all evening, and nobody in town talks people round like she does.
halloween.heroinfo.annie.quote: Hold on, I've got another call.
halloween.heroinfo.annie.trait: Talks townsfolk round and calls the police faster.
halloween.heroinfo.lynda.story: Everything is "totally" fine with Lynda: the party, the boyfriend, the beer. She doesn't scare easily, and that may save her life.
halloween.heroinfo.lynda.trait: Panic builds up more slowly in her.
halloween.heroinfo.rachel.story: Her pumpkin will be the scariest on the street. Rachel has carved lanterns since she was little and knows how to fool someone who goes by ear.
halloween.heroinfo.rachel.quote: Let him come to the light.
halloween.heroinfo.rachel.skill: Sets down a lit pumpkin that rattles and creaks as if someone were there: he goes for the noise.
halloween.heroinfo.tanya.story: A couple more houses and the bag is full. Tanya knows where every house keeps its sweets. And not only sweets.
halloween.heroinfo.jennifer.story: One more chapter before bed. Jennifer has read every mystery in the library and notices what others walk past.
halloween.heroinfo.jennifer.quote: The clues are always close by.
halloween.heroinfo.jennifer.skill: For a moment shows what is hidden nearby that could get them out of town.
halloween.heroinfo.alexis.story: The baby is asleep at last. Alexis stands at the window looking out at the yard: someone is there, she can feel it.
halloween.heroinfo.alexis.trait: Feels him near even when he can't be seen: a sign on her screen.
halloween.heroinfo.bob.story: Friday, beer and a friend's car. Bob is big and stubborn: he doesn't go down easily.
halloween.heroinfo.eric.story: He'll have that old wreck running by midnight. Eric understands engines better than people.
halloween.heroinfo.eric.trait: The repair kit often lasts after a fix.
halloween.heroinfo.marcus.story: The best way to scare someone: a flashlight under the chin. Marcus has scared the little ones all night; tonight it's his turn.
halloween.heroinfo.marcus.trait: His flashlight reaches further and blinds wider.
halloween.heroinfo.thomas.story: The leaves won't rake themselves. Thomas works quietly and is used to nobody noticing him: tonight that comes in handy.
halloween.heroinfo.thomas.trait: His footsteps carry half as far.
halloween.heroinfo.richard.story: The paper says a patient escaped from Smith's Grove. Richard is the only one who took it seriously.
halloween.heroinfo.richard.quote: I told you. I told everyone.
halloween.heroinfo.richard.skill: Michael in his sight is shown to every survivor for a while.
halloween.heroinfo.michael.story: Fifteen years ago, on Halloween, six-year-old Michael Myers killed his sister. Tonight he escaped from Smith's Grove and came home.
halloween.heroinfo.michael.sense.desc: Held: he walks slowly and stalks whoever he looks at.
halloween.heroinfo.michael.jump.desc: Into the shadows: fast, unseen, through doors. He can only come out in the dark.
halloween.heroinfo.michael.dash.desc: A short burst of speed, loud steps.
halloween.heroinfo.michael.impulse.desc: Shows the survivors around for a moment.
halloween.heroinfo.michael.weakness: No coming out of Shape Jump in the light. Flashlights and firecrackers blind him, and the police can cuff him.
halloween.heroinfo.michael.tip: Kill the lights in a house before going in: in the dark you come out of the shadows right behind them.
halloween.heroinfo.demogorgon.story: A creature of the Upside Down, the dark copy of the town under the ground. The lights flicker when it climbs up.
halloween.heroinfo.demogorgon.quote: The lights go out. It's here.
halloween.heroinfo.demogorgon.upside.des: Down under the ground: five times as fast, the houses with survivors glowing. Comes up on the spot, five seconds in plain view.
halloween.heroinfo.demogorgon.shred.desc: A second's wind-up, then a lunge that breaks doors and windows.
halloween.heroinfo.demogorgon.impulse.de: Shows the survivors around for a moment.
halloween.heroinfo.demogorgon.weakness: A burning road flare shuts the Upside Down round it. Climbing out, he is seen and heard.
halloween.heroinfo.demogorgon.tip: Come up behind a wall of a house glowing red: for five seconds they can't see you from the room.
halloween.heroinfo.vecna.story: He sees what people fear and chooses one. The cursed one hears a clock, closer with every stroke.
halloween.heroinfo.vecna.grip.desc: Hold, aim, let go: a pillar flies where you looked and draws whoever it catches to you.
halloween.heroinfo.vecna.eyes.desc: Sees through the eyes of the nearest survivor while the reserve lasts.
halloween.heroinfo.vecna.anchor.desc: Moves to a cursed one of his choosing and takes shape beside them for three seconds.
halloween.heroinfo.vecna.weakness: Slow, no dash. A step aside dodges the Grip; a stun breaks it.
halloween.heroinfo.vecna.tip: Throw the Grip where they will run, not where they are.
halloween.hero.gossip.heard: %s told everyone: you see each other
halloween.heroinfo.annie.skill: Rings round everyone: for 6 seconds the survivors see each other through walls.
halloween.heroinfo.lynda.skill: No panic, full breath, and 5 seconds of running without tiring.
halloween.heroinfo.tanya.skill: Her next search within 30 seconds is near instant.
halloween.heroinfo.alexis.skill: For 8 seconds her steps make no sound and she can't be stalked.
halloween.heroinfo.bob.skill: A shoulder charge: Michael in the way goes down stunned, a door flies open, a locked one breaks.
halloween.heroinfo.eric.skill: For 15 seconds repairs, searches and other long jobs go twice as fast.
halloween.heroinfo.marcus.skill: Flashlight full on under his chin: blinds Michael ahead for 3 seconds, light in hand or not.
halloween.heroinfo.thomas.skill: Down in the leaves: for 10 seconds, until he moves, neither Michael nor the bots see him.
